correctness.rationale: Differentiating log(beta S I) gives (log c)prime=(log beta)prime+H, so H>=0 and monotonic beta imply the sum of disjoint peak-to-trough logarithmic drops is bounded by total log beta decline. The Gaussian pulses of q=-beta prime/beta are positive analytic with arbitrarily small integrated mass and uniformly bounded height; H remains in explicit positive bounds, so derivative changes signs at every center/midpoint while I increases. Shrinking fixed-mass pulses makes the prominence/log-budget ratio approach one. Reviewed exact rational guard inequalities and numerical verifier, with infinitely-many-peaks conclusion from analytic estimates, not RK4.
